findings.text: follow-on: the reflowed comment says the attention mark 'was dropped at the lead's direction' after being 'tried by an earlier revision' — role attribution and changelog prose the naming rules forbid; state the mechanism ('the row draws no attention column between the clock and the stage') instead.

follow-on: state_columns.add(NEW_STATE_COLUMN) adds a constant rather than a measured column, so the guard assert len(state_columns) == 1 is a tautology that cannot fail; the state column is never actually measured off the rendered row (pre-existing, but in a test this node edited).

follow-on: the expected value is built from ticker_module.DIM_MARKER and ticker_module.RATE_UNIT, the same constants the renderer prints, so that assertion moves with the code it guards; only the companion '0.00' not-in-line check is independent of the value under test.
